title: Dominic and the Border
author: Theo Thornbury
blurb: Hazel Fairweather, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, has spent fifteen years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
